questions.question_en: Which agricultural relationship identifies Aggregation?
questions.question_te: ఉత్పత్తి సమీకరణం గురించి సరైన వివరణ/సంబంధం ఏది?

Containment and protection suited to product handling requirements
Transforming raw produce into another usable or stable product form
Pooling produce from multiple suppliers for handling or marketing

ఈ వివరణ ప్యాకేజింగ్ (Packaging)కు చెందినది. ఉత్పత్తి సమీకరణంకు సరైన సంబంధం: Pooling produce from multiple suppliers for handling or marketing.

questions.question_te: నిల్వ గురించి సరైన వివరణ/సంబంధం ఏది?

Connection from production to processing, distribution and buyers
Coordination of movement, handling and delivery through a chain

questions.question_te: 100kg batchలో10kgloss అయితే saleable mass ఎంత?

110 kg
100 kg regardless of loss
90 kg

Loss does not add mass.
The stated loss changes remaining mass.

questions.question_en: Which factor is necessary beyond raw-crop abundance for a viable processing chain?

options: Reliable supply, utilities, skills, logistics and markets
Assume transport costs are zero
Ignore waste and effluent
Only the crop name
option_explanations: A processing network needs operational and market conditions.
Costs affect location/viability.
Waste management is a real requirement.
A name does not establish feasibility.
questions.heading: పాఠం 5 — పొలంలో పండినది వినియోగదారునికి ఎలా చేరుతుంది?
questions.excerpt: Backward linkages inputs/servicesను, forward linkages processing/distribution/buyersను connect చేస్తాయి. Local production abundance alone a viable processing industryకు guarantee కాదు: reliable supply, scale, energy/water, skills, markets, waste management అవసరం.

questions.question_en: Why should a high quality grade not be treated as complete proof of food safety?
questions.question_te: High grade complete food-safety proof ఎందుకు కాదు?
options: Grade criteria and safety hazards are different assessment dimensions
Appearance detects every contaminant
Standards need no definitions
Traceability eliminates all contamination automatically
option_explanations: Quality categories may not cover all biological/chemical hazards.
Some hazards are not visible.
Scope and criteria must be defined.
Records support control but do not guarantee absence.
questions.heading: పాఠం 5 — పొలంలో పండినది వినియోగదారునికి ఎలా చేరుతుంది?
questions.excerpt: Traceability batch historyను, quality assurance process controlsను, grading product classesను సూచిస్తాయి. Quality grade food-safety guaranteeకు complete substitute కాదు. Processing by-products useful inputs కావచ్చు; untreated wasteను resourceగా పేరు మార్చడం safe circularity కాదు.
